the structural colourisation of metal surface is possible by means of laser induced ripples and that the defects in the ripple structure can be used to improve the quality of structural colouration.

the defects in the periodic ripples induced by laser pulses can make the colours of the surface observable in a larger viewing angle range, which is important for practical applications.

the influence of the defects on the colourisation of metallic surfaces and the influence of laser parameters on the spectral properties of the generated ripples.
